targets.review_note: A full playoff with odd n requires exactly (n-1)/2 wins per team. Subtract already known wins and process vertices in increasing order. For a vertex, the number of wins on its still undecided edges to later vertices is now forced by its remaining requirement. Enumerate exactly those subsets, decrementing each later opponent requirement on an edge the current vertex loses. Reject negative or impossible requirements and memoize the remaining requirement tuple. Every completion has one unique sequence of chosen subsets, so the count is exact without tournament symmetry division. Parallel datasets have separate graphs and memoization.
